definitions.uncertainty: 10,000 percentile bootstrap resamples of independent process pairs, seed 263; exploratory with 3 or 5 rounds
definitions.effects: positive reduction means candidate has a smaller metric. For requests_per_second, negate reduction and reverse CI endpoints to express throughput increase.
definitions.lifecycle: original accounted envelope: launch/setup + completed requests + updates + retirement; excludes oracle validation
definitions.throughput: requests per summed completed burst duration; not sustained serving
definitions.instrumentation: negative reduction means overhead; profiled samples have fewer requests and are diagnostic only
